compute_deformable_detr_segmentation_los: compute the Deformable DETR loss for object segmentation given logits, labels, boxes, and masks
compute_deformable_detr_detection_loss: compute the Deformable DETR loss for object detection given logits, labels, and predicted boxes
build_deformable_detr_hungarian_matcher: build a Deformable DETR Hungarian matcher that computes classification, L1 bbox, and GIoU costs for bipartite matching
create_deformable_detr_image_loss: create a Deformable DETR image loss criterion that computes classification and cardinality errors
run_deformable_detr_loss_cardinality: run the cardinality error computation to measure absolute difference between predicted and target object counts
